name: TimberBeam
height_note: H 0..65535 spans height_range_m; mid level about 0.630

colour_spaces.N: linear, OpenGL (+Y up); flip green on Unreal import
colour_spaces.ORM: linear; R AO, G roughness, B metallic 0
colour_spaces.Macro: linear; R large, G medium, B small low-frequency variation, sample at 1/6 to 1/10 of the tile UV scale

method: Poly Haven weathered_brown_planks (broad sawn boards, grain along U), graded to the orange-brown of the original exterior timbers; beams map inside single boards
known_weaknesses: sawn, not hewn: adze marks come only from the beam geometry; never rendered in the 4x4 tiling check, only seen on the wall and town kits
